parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is offering 1 Wheat for 1 Brick. My current hand is 1 Brick, 3 Wheat, and 2 Wood. I am desperately short on Sheep and need Brick to build roads or settlements. Trading away my only Brick for a 4th Wheat is counterproductive, especially since I already have plenty of Wheat and no way to use it without other resources. Claude likely needs the Brick to build a settlement or road to expand. While I want to stay on good terms with him to counter Gemma, this specific trade doesn't help me and actively hurts my building prospects.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Claude's Wheat for Brick trade. I have 3 Wheat and only 1 Brick; giving up the Brick makes no sense right now. Need to find a way to get Sheep or more Brick.
parsed.say_outloud: קלוד, יש לי כבר שלוש חיטה ביד ורק טיט אחד. הטיט הזה יקר לי מדי כרגע בשביל עוד חיטה שאני לא יכול להשתמש בה. מצטער, אולי בפעם אחרת.
